question: Median of 14, 14, 15, 17, 16, 17, 17, 22, 13 is:
solution:
Given:

14, 14, 15, 17, 16, 17, 17, 22, 13

Concept used:

The median is the middle value in a list ordered from smallest to largest.

Calculation:

Given series in the ascending order,

13, 14, 14, 15, 16, 17, 17, 17, 22

Hence, the median = 16

∴ The median of the given series is 16.
